intrebari.intrebare: Judging by her expression, the woman has some ______ gossip to share.
intrebari.explicatie: juicy gossip = interesting, often shocking information about other people.

intrebari.intrebare: 'You'll never guess what happened!' is a phrase typically used to ______.
intrebari.explicatie: This fixed phrase prepares the listener for something surprising.

intrebari.intrebare: The two friends talk so easily that there is never a ______ in the conversation.
intrebari.explicatie: a lull in the conversation = a short period when nobody speaks.

intrebari.intrebare: The croissants and cakes are ______ prepared every morning.
intrebari.explicatie: freshly prepared = made only a short time ago.

intrebari.intrebare: Before sitting down, the friends hugged and exchanged ______.
intrebari.explicatie: exchange greetings = say hello to each other.

intrebari.intrebare: The story was so funny that it had them both ______.
intrebari.explicatie: Idiom: have someone in stitches = make someone laugh a lot.

intrebari.intrebare: The waiter clearly has a cheerful, ______ personality.
intrebari.explicatie: An outgoing personality is friendly and sociable.

intrebari.intrebare: The woman insists on paying the bill: 'Put your money away — ______!'
intrebari.explicatie: Fixed phrase: It's my treat = I'm paying for this.

intrebari.intrebare: The angry passenger is ______ her dissatisfaction with the airline.
intrebari.explicatie: register your dissatisfaction = officially complain (formal).

intrebari.intrebare: Tempers ______ as one flight after another was delayed.
intrebari.explicatie: tempers flare = people suddenly become angry.

intrebari.intrebare: The passenger is seeking ______ that she will get a seat on the next flight.
intrebari.explicatie: seek assurances = ask for a promise that something will happen.

intrebari.intrebare: The cancellation ______ the young man's hopes of a quick trip home.
intrebari.explicatie: dash someone's hopes = destroy them.

intrebari.intrebare: The exhausted traveller has dozed off after a night of ______ awake worrying about the trip.
intrebari.explicatie: lie awake = stay in bed without being able to sleep. lie → lying (intransitive); lay → laying (needs an object).

intrebari.intrebare: Arriving at the gate at 11:59 for a 12:00 departure is really ______.
intrebari.explicatie: Idiom: cut it fine = leave yourself very little time to do something.

intrebari.intrebare: Racing through the terminal with a heavy suitcase, she's pushing herself to the ______.
intrebari.explicatie: push yourself to the limit = make the greatest possible effort.

intrebari.intrebare: When she lands, she'll text her family to say she has arrived ______.
intrebari.explicatie: Fixed phrase: safe and sound = unharmed. The word order never changes.

intrebari.intrebare: When he read the first question, he ______ a blank.
intrebari.explicatie: draw a blank = be unable to remember or think of something.

intrebari.intrebare: He has been struggling under a ______ workload all term.
intrebari.explicatie: a heavy workload = a lot of work to do.

intrebari.intrebare: He studied the formula, but now it has completely ______ his mind.
intrebari.explicatie: slip your mind = be forgotten.

intrebari.intrebare: His heart was ______ as he turned over the exam paper.
intrebari.explicatie: your heart pounds = it beats very fast and strongly, because of fear or excitement.

intrebari.intrebare: He is ______ delighted with his result.
intrebari.explicatie: 'Delighted' is a strong adjective, so it collocates with 'absolutely', not with 'very'.

intrebari.intrebare: All his hard work has clearly ______ results.
intrebari.explicatie: produce results = have a successful effect.

intrebari.intrebare: He's been walking on ______ ever since he saw his mark.
intrebari.explicatie: Idiom: walk on air = feel extremely happy.

intrebari.intrebare: Seeing his success, the girl ______ him a compliment.
intrebari.explicatie: pay someone a compliment = say something nice about them.

intrebari.intrebare: The hikers are walking through ______ hills, far from the city.
intrebari.explicatie: rolling hills = gentle hills that rise and fall like waves.

intrebari.intrebare: The little village lies in the ______ of the countryside.
intrebari.explicatie: in the heart of the countryside = deep in the countryside, far from towns.

intrebari.intrebare: Long walks in nature help the bearded man ______ inspiration for his paintings.
intrebari.explicatie: find inspiration = get new ideas.

intrebari.intrebare: Both friends clearly have a strong ______ of adventure.
intrebari.explicatie: a sense of adventure = a love of new and exciting experiences.

intrebari.intrebare: It's ______ cold and the woman is shivering.
intrebari.explicatie: bitterly cold = extremely cold.

intrebari.intrebare: The storm came completely out of the ______: nobody expected it.
intrebari.explicatie: Idiom: out of the blue = suddenly and unexpectedly.

intrebari.intrebare: Still, every cloud has a silver ______: at least the fields will be green.
intrebari.explicatie: Idiom: every cloud has a silver lining = something good comes even from a bad situation.

intrebari.intrebare: After a day in the cold rain, the man went ______ with flu.
intrebari.explicatie: go down with flu = become ill with flu.

intrebari.intrebare: The noise of the alarm is so terrible that the boy is about to throw a ______.
intrebari.explicatie: throw a tantrum = suddenly behave angrily and noisily, like a small child. (We 'lose our temper'; we don't 'throw' it.)

intrebari.intrebare: The dad's plan for an impressive dinner literally went up in ______.
intrebari.explicatie: Idiom: go up in smoke = fail completely. Here it is also literally true!

intrebari.intrebare: When the smoke alarm went off, the dad's ______ sank.
intrebari.explicatie: your heart sinks = you suddenly feel disappointed or worried.

intrebari.intrebare: He had been ______ with the idea of cooking a big family dinner for weeks.
intrebari.explicatie: toy with an idea = think about it, but not very seriously.

intrebari.intrebare: The meat is so ______ that it almost melts in your mouth.
intrebari.explicatie: tender meat = soft and easy to cut and eat.

intrebari.intrebare: The salads are made with ______ sourced vegetables from a nearby farm.
intrebari.explicatie: locally sourced = produced near where it is sold or eaten. An adverb is needed before the participle 'sourced'.

intrebari.intrebare: Next year they want to invite more relatives, not just their ______ family.
intrebari.explicatie: immediate family = your closest relatives: parents, children, brothers and sisters.

intrebari.intrebare: Mum and Dad are raising their glasses to ______ a toast.
intrebari.explicatie: propose a toast = ask everyone to drink to someone or something.
